recommendation: Keep this commit as the FHIR-40607 source fix. If FHIR-44735 is later applied, handle the THO migration of all-time-units and related UCUM value sets as a separate issue rather than enumerating all possible UCUM time expressions in core.
issue_request: FHIR-40607 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6. It requested internal consistency among duration-units, all-time-units, and ucum-common by using singular displays such as day, and it called out that all-time-units was not expanding correctly.
initial_application: No FHIR-40607-tagged commit was found. The build-scoped Duration datatype binding still used valueset-duration-units and valueset-all-time-units, but duration-units retained plural displays and all-time-units still filtered UCUM canonical=a, which expands to zero concepts on tx.fhir.org.
additional_context: ucum-common already provides singular displays for the same duration codes. FHIR-I minutes from 2023-03-27 corroborate that UCUM displays are tooling-generated, that all-time-units could not expand in R5, and that singular day was the accepted target. Later FHIR-44735/UP-481 migration work is related but separate and is not Applied/Published in this run scope for core source reconciliation.
reconciliation: Changed source/datatypes/valueset-duration-units.xml displays from plural to singular and changed source/datatypes/valueset-all-time-units.xml from canonical a/year to canonical s/second with matching description text.
source_changes: source/datatypes/valueset-duration-units.xml: changed explicit UCUM duration concept displays from plural to singular: millisecond, second, minute, hour, day, week, month, and year.
source/datatypes/valueset-all-time-units.xml: changed the UCUM canonical filter from a/year to s/second and updated the description so the value set expands for time-duration units.

related_jiras.note: Broader UCUM value set migration was recorded as Resolved - No Change because UP-481 and FHIR-44735 carry the remaining migration work.

Resolved - change required issue says all-time-units and all-distance-units should be retained/migrated to THO because they are used as maximum bindings; it is not Applied/Published in this default run scope.
Implemented UTG migration for ucum-common and ucum-units, supporting the conclusion that this seed should not move all-time-units out of core.
